name: apiplant-e2e
description: End-to-end tests: a real database, a real apiplant server, and the admin dashboard driven in a browser.

scripts.shots: pnpm shots:admin && pnpm shots:back-office && pnpm shots:impersonation && pnpm shots:ai && pnpm shots:studio && pnpm shots:cli && pnpm shots:optimize
scripts.shots:back-office:light: SHOTS_THEME=light APP_DIR=examples/27-back-office APP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8106 playwright test --config screenshots.config.ts shots/back-office.shots.ts
scripts.shots:back-office:dark: SHOTS_THEME=dark APP_DIR=examples/27-back-office APP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8106 playwright test --config screenshots.config.ts shots/back-office.shots.ts
scripts.shots:impersonation:light: SHOTS_THEME=light APP_DIR=examples/27-back-office APP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8106 playwright test --config screenshots.config.ts shots/impersonation.shots.ts
scripts.shots:impersonation:dark: SHOTS_THEME=dark APP_DIR=examples/27-back-office APP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8106 playwright test --config screenshots.config.ts shots/impersonation.shots.ts
scripts.shots:ai:light: SHOTS_THEME=light APP_DIR=examples/19-ai APP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8102 playwright test --config screenshots.config.ts shots/ai.shots.ts
